text:
alex (Docs): Quick heads-up — we need a coordinated deprecation notice + migration snippets for the v1->v2 API and the recent model id swap. Targeting public deprecation banner next Wed. Who can take which items? tl;dr: docs landing page, migration examples (ts/py), SDK changelog, PR link checks, customer banner copy.

maria (SDK): I can own SDK snippets. Breaking rename: `client.models.get` -> `client.model.fetch` and payload shape changed (now `model: { id }`). I'll open PR with TS/py examples. Need doc link to stable model map.

sam (Eng): Note: fallback semantics changed — v1 `auto-fallback` true by default now false. If you rely on implicit fallbacks you must set `policy: { fallback: true }`. Also model ids: `redwood/small` -> `rw/small-v2`. I'll post mapping CSV in the PR.

lucy (PM): Timeline check — banner copy by Tue EOD, docs publish Wed AM. Customer comms owner? @sam take the technical note, @alex can you handle the banner?

deploy-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/748 — alex/dep-notice (checks running)

alex (Docs): I've added a short checklist in the PR description: 1) update migration guide w/ snippets 2) add model id mapping table 3) update SDK changelog + examples 4) fix any broken links 5) schedule banner. I'll assign items in PR. Assigning: maria (2,3), sam (1,2), lucy (5), alex (4).

maria (SDK): snippet preview:
```
// TS example for v2 migration
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const res = await client.model.fetch({ model: { id: 'rw/small-v2' }, input: 'Summarize the quarterly notes.' });
console.log(res.output);
```
I'll include equivalent Python and a short diff showing the old -> new call. Also note streaming token header changed from `x-rw-stream` -> `x-rw-chunk`.

sam (Eng): adding mapping CSV to PR now: `redwood_sku,old_id,new_id` rows. Pushing in ~10m. Also flagging that the model swap has a ~5-7% latency increase on small seqs, adding perf note to the FAQ.

lucy (PM): +1 to the perf FAQ entry. Also add a one-liner in the banner about temporarily different latency characteristics so customers aren't surprised.

alex (Docs): Great — I'll merge banner copy into marketing/comm once PR is green and ping #announcements. Update this thread when snippets pushed or if CI fails. :thumbsup:
